records.title: Configured owner and effective owner remain separate states
records.blocker: The product API, persistent state and host read-back path do not yet expose desired, effective and pending owner independently.

records.title: Idle complete bundle can be switched live as one transaction
records.blocker: The product host-owner controller has no all-member live rebind transaction with driver and owner read-back commit.

records.title: Live activation is committed only after effective-owner read-back
records.blocker: No product API/read-back test proves that Active is derived from current driver ownership rather than reboot history or desired configuration.

records.title: Deferred owner change preserves current owner and reports reboot required
records.blocker: The product does not persist a pending boot claim while leaving effective owner unchanged and returning the exact reboot disposition.

records.title: Busy host consumer prevents partial owner conversion
records.blocker: Persistent and transient host-consumer detection is not integrated with atomic apply-now/deferred rejection and subsequent clean retry.

records.title: Independent sibling can switch without disturbing a busy sibling
records.blocker: The product lacks an authoritative dependent-device boundary and a live-rebind A/B test proving an unrelated busy sibling remains untouched.

records.title: Shared dependent-device siblings are expanded and prechecked together
records.blocker: The product controller does not yet expand a shared dependency before busy-state precheck and reject the whole request without partial rebind.

records.title: Stale physical identity is denied rather than repaired by reboot advice
records.blocker: The owner activation API is not connected to immutable identity and physical-path comparison with a stable ACTIVATION_IDENTITY_MISMATCH result.

records.title: Early-boot claim commits Active only after boot-time reconciliation
records.blocker: There is no production early-boot agent that validates identity, group, driver and effective owner before committing Active.

records.title: Disabling an active bundle is all-or-nothing and lease aware
records.blocker: The product has no lease-aware quiesce and host-driver restore transaction that keeps the entire bundle out of partial owner states.

records.title: Shared dependency collision blocks a second VM until complete release
records.blocker: VM admission does not yet enforce one durable owner for a shared dependent-device bundle across functions and VMs.
